faqs.q: What is a Diagnostic HVAC Assessment?
faqs.a: It's a comprehensive review of your HVAC system - every component, wiring, and your ventilation system - to make sure everything is functional. It's recommended every 3-6 months to avoid costly repairs or replacements.

There's a combined rebate of up to $2,800 on qualifying energy-efficient Amana systems - up to $800 from TVA plus up to $2,000 from the U.S. Government; qualification depends on specific criteria. TVA rebates can also apply to qualifying heat pumps and mini-split systems, and even certain repairs.

faqs.q: How can a mini-split help my home?
faqs.a: Mini-splits offer flexible heating and cooling, especially for homes without ductwork. They're energy-efficient and allow zone control, so you can set different temperatures in different areas.
